title: Austin Pays for Dam Land, Waives Fines, OKs Ads
summary:
*   **Dam Compensation:** Approved significant payments to multiple property owners whose land was submerged or damaged by the lake created by the city's Colorado River dam.
*   **Traffic Fine Leniency:** Remitted half of a fine for a driver whose car headlights accidentally went out, noting his good reputation and the well-lit street.
*   **Public Health Investment:** Allocated funds to purchase and install screens at the new City Hospital.
*   **Early Street Advertising:** Granted a conditional permit to the Austin Baseball Club to hang an advertisement banner across Congress Avenue on game days.

Resolved by the City Council of the City of Austin : That ,upon consideration of the
showing made By W Raunick to the effect that the this was his first offense and that he

wereoff ,and in consideration of the excellent reputation of the said W Raunick for
sobriety and orderliness,one-half of the fine and costs imposed upon the said W Raunick in
cause No 9268,in the Corporation Court of the City of Austin , Texas,on the 9th day of
April 1915, and amounting to $ 19.80,be and the same are hereby remitted ,and
Be it further resolved :
That the sum of $ 9.90,be and the same is hereby appropriated out of the General
Contingent fund of the City of Austin,Texas, for thecurrent year as a refund to the said W
Raunick of the money heretofore paid into the Treasuryof the City of Austin,Texas,on
account of the fine and costs imposed in the above numbered cause.
